description: This file defines abstract base classes for log-consistent grains using event sourcing in Orleans. It includes classes for managing grain state, raising events, handling log view updates, and protocol participation, serving as a core component for event-sourced grain implementations.

classes.name: JournaledGrain<TGrainState>
classes.description: Abstract base class for log-consistent grains with a generic grain state, extending the more detailed generic class with object as event type.

classes.name: JournaledGrain<TGrainState, TEventBase>
classes.description: Abstract base class implementing event sourcing logic, including event raising, state management, and protocol participation for grains.

methods.name: RaiseEvent
methods.description: Raises a single event and submits it to the log view adaptor.

methods.name: RaiseEvents
methods.description: Raises multiple events atomically.

methods.name: RaiseConditionalEvent
methods.description: Attempts to append an event conditionally, succeeding only if no conflicts occur.

methods.name: RaiseConditionalEvents
methods.description: Attempts to append multiple events atomically, conditionally.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Gets the current confirmed state of the grain.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Gets the version number of the current confirmed state.

methods.name: OnTentativeStateChanged
methods.description: Hook for reacting to tentative state changes.

methods.name: TentativeState
methods.description: Gets the current tentative state including unconfirmed events.

methods.name: OnStateChanged
methods.description: Hook for reacting to confirmed state changes.

methods.name: ConfirmEvents
methods.description: Waits until all previously raised events are confirmed.

methods.name: RefreshNow
methods.description: Synchronizes the state, ensuring the latest confirmed state and confirming all pending events.

methods.name: RetrieveConfirmedEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a segment of confirmed events between specified versions.

methods.name: OnConnectionIssue
methods.description: Handles connection issues in the log protocol.

methods.name: OnConnectionIssueResolved
methods.description: Handles resolution of connection issues.

methods.name: TransitionState
methods.description: Applies an event to the state, typically by invoking a dynamic 'Apply' method.

methods.name: InstallAdaptor
methods.description: Installs the log view adaptor during grain activation.

methods.name: DefaultAdaptorFactory
methods.description: Provides the default factory for creating log view adaptors if none is specified.

methods.name: UpdateView
methods.description: Updates the grain state view when new log entries are appended.

methods.name: PreActivateProtocolParticipant
methods.description: Notifies the adaptor before activation.

methods.name: PostActivateProtocolParticipant
methods.description: Notifies the adaptor after activation.

methods.name: DeactivateProtocolParticipant
methods.description: Notifies the adaptor of deactivation.

methods.name: OnViewChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to the view, indicating tentative and confirmed states.

methods.name: OnConnectionIssue
methods.description: Handles connection issues reported by the adaptor.

methods.name: OnConnectionIssueResolved
methods.description: Handles resolution of connection issues.
